subject: Marine Works - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Fraser River
Combi-Wall Material Offloading will take place in the vicinity of Deas Island Casting Basin 49 07.275N 123 04.310W.
Derrick and Scow barge movements will be outside of main navigation channel. FRPD D.Reid will be spudded down near the shoreline of Deas Island.
Hours of operation are daily from 1400UTC Oct 29th to 0200UTC Nov 2nd.
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch. 16, 74 and 71.
Mariners are requested to transit the main navigation channel.
